g.text: Historical Hartree ratio = 0.0776221; Nyquist-safe ratio = 0.0776219; maximum Parseval relative error = 1.30 x 10^-15. For each matched pair, R_H = sqrt(E_ZFP/E_SZ3) x sqrt(S_H,ZFP/S_H,SZ3), with S_H = [sum |Delta rho(G)|^2/|G|^4] / [sum |Delta rho(G)|^2]. Panel C reports separately aggregated material-level centers, so the displayed centers need not multiply exactly.
Exact ZFP/SZ3 common-support audit: 457 matched pairs across 214 materials. The Nyquist-safe operator reproduces the historical codec effect while restoring exact Fourier/real-space parity.
